summary.name: ONLYOFFICE
summary.one_liner: ONLYOFFICE is an open-source office suite with document, spreadsheet, and presentation editors, offered as self-hosted Docs and desktop, mobile, and web apps.
use_cases: collaborate on documents with a team
embed document editing into a platform
edit documents across desktop and mobile devices
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes ONLYOFFICE as a private, AI-powered office infrastructure for document collaboration and workflow automation. ONLYOFFICE Docs is described as a document editing engine that can be added to an ecosystem, with desktop and mobile apps built on top. The apps are said to let users access, edit, and collaborate on documents from any device while keeping data under their control. The page also mentions connecting Docs and apps to a platform, embedding them, or building a custom workspace, plus intelligent assistants. It lists a Docker image with over 101 million pulls and a release note for ONLYOFFICE Docs 10.0.
notable: Open-source document editing engine (ONLYOFFICE Docs) that can be self-hosted or embedded
Desktop and mobile apps for editing documents while keeping data under user control
Docker image with over 101 million pulls
Includes AI-powered intelligent assistants and workflow automation
caveats: Page does not state specific pricing tiers; the free apps are mentioned but paid plans are not detailed
Platform list is inferred from the desktop/mobile/Docker references and the Mac listing; exact supported platforms are not fully specified on this page
